title: ORR durability study on Pt3.7Mn/KB, Pt3.9Co/KB and Pt3.7Ni/KB for heavy-duty vehicle operation
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,1024-1031
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00059A, Paper
Open Access

Galindev Oyunbileg, Garavdorj Batnyagt, Waka Nagano, Hidenobu Wakita, Koichi Ui, Tatsuya Takeguchi
Since durability is a key challenge for the use of robust catalysts in fuel cell systems for heavy-duty vehicles (HDV, a durability target of 50 000 h) applications, the durability of various core–shell Pt-based alloy catalysts is evaluated.
